data.title: G5: board --json no longer grows with history by default
data.description: Measured 2026-10-12 on a 30-task journal: board --json 17 KB at 30 events, 82 KB at 300 (~240 B per event); --summary stays at 7.5 KB. Owner decided: the summary shape becomes the default, full history behind --history, announced as a contract change under the deprecation policy (DOC-65).
